uncited: Provides fundamental linear algebra operations for 3x3 and 4x4 matrices, including norms, transposition, and multiplication variants.

It serves as the computational core for [Custom Matrix Math Library](3216-custom-matrix-math-library.md), enabling the construction of view matrices and ray generation logic without external dependencies.
It distinguishes itself by offering explicit, unoptimized implementations for small fixed-size matrices, prioritizing clarity and correctness over performance.
Multiplies the transpose of a 3x3 matrix by a 3D vector.
Multiplies a 2x3 matrix by a 3x3 matrix, resulting in a 2x3 matrix.
Computes the Euclidean norm (length) of a 4D vector.
All operations are $O(1)$ with respect to input size, as they operate on fixed-size matrices (3x3 or 4x4).
Memory usage is minimal, requiring only the storage of the input and output matrices/vectors.
Symmetric optimizations reduce computation for $A^T A$ and symmetric norms.
Use for small-scale transformations in custom rendering engines or educational implementations where dependency management is critical.
Avoid for large-scale scientific computing or real-time rendering with massive vertex buffers where hardware-accelerated or SIMD-optimized libraries are preferred.
